text:
Alice: Quick scan — where's the canonical KV/prefix cache hit-rate dashboard? need to validate canary from yesterday's rollout.

ben: It's in Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv_cache/kv-prefix-hit-rates — panels 'global hitrate', 'by-model', 'evictions'.

carla: that url is behind SSO, but direct panel id is 42. The metric to look at is `kv_prefix_cache_hitrate{pool=~"prod.*"}` and `kv_cache_prefetch_hit_rate` for prefetch. Also check `prefix_cache_evictions_total`.

dave: If you want traces, use Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.internal/trace?q=prefix_cache and filter service=kv-serving; look at requests with cache.miss=true.

Alice: thx. Any owner for the dashboard? want to ping someone for alert tuning — we saw a drop to 55% during canary.

carla: dashboard owner is @dave, but cc @ben — evictions spiked because of a sudden seq_len distribution change. We tweaked the prefetch window last week which might interact.

ben: For alerts, see Prom rule `KVPrefixCacheLowHitrate`. Current expr: `avg_over_time(kv_prefix_cache_hitrate[5m]) < 0.6` — seems noisy. Suggest changing to `avg_over_time(kv_prefix_cache_hitrate[10m]) < 0.5 and rate(prefix_requests_total[1m]) > 10` to avoid low-traffic false positives.

dave: Agreed, also add `for: 10m` on the alert to prevent flapping. I can open a PR to tweak the rule.

Alice: please do. Also paste the grafana panel link showing traces/logs for the affected window so I can forward to CS.

obs-bot: (auto) Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache — contains dashboards, alerts, owners, and tuning playbook.

carla: For logs use Loki: `{job="kv-serving"} |= "cache miss" | json` then join on request_id to Tempo traces. We had a few requests with large prompt sizes.

ben: I'll open a small PR for alert change and add a note in the runbook about seq_len edgecases. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/infra/alerts/pulls/123

dave: Reviewing now, will merge after CI passes. :thumbsup:

Alice: perfect, thanks. If hit rate doesn't recover within 2 hours we'll rollback the canary. :eyes:

ben: FYI I also added a short grafana panel showing per-model hitrate percentiles — helps spot long-tail models.

Alice: great — keep me posted, will check back in 90m.

carla: ping me if you want me to run a small synthetic load to reproduce.

dave: merged the PR, alert thresholds updated. Monitor looks better so far.

Alice: closing loop — will reopen if anything regresses. Thanks all.
